email.subject: AI for Meltzer, Lippe, Goldstein & Breitstone - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dawn,

With Bankruptcy and Real Estate Taxation practices spanning Long Island, NYC, and Florida, Meltzer, Lippe, Goldstein & Breitstone handles the kind of complex, high-stakes work that demands both precision and scale. That's exactly what we're solving for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
